newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Lisnave denies planning capital call.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Lisnave denies planning capital call.

text.p: Ship repairer Lisnave-Estaleiros Navais de Lisboa denied on Friday a press report that the new company to emerge from a restructuring would make a capital call.
"There is no truth to forecasts for a future capital increase in the operating company," it said in a statement.

Financial weekly Semanario Economico reported that the operating arm, which will take over the group's activities with a reduced workforce, would boost capital to give it the same bourse capitalisation as the old firm.
The old firm's capital was written down tenfold under an accord between the Mello Group and the government to save the troubled company.
